admin.answerFlagsOnly_one: Everything served has been collected, but {count} thing below needs you.
admin.answerFlagsOnly_other: Everything served has been collected, but {count} things below need you.
admin.flag.priceBody: {no} sold {product} at {recorded}; the price is now {price}
admin.flag.shiftBody: Counted at {time}. The shortfall is recorded against the shift.
admin.byHourAria: Sales per hour from {from} to {to}, highest at {peak}
admin.revokedTitle: Sent by {device} after it was revoked
admin.effect.void: Approving takes {amount} off {no} and puts {items} back in stock.
admin.effect.voidWhole: Approving cancels {no} and puts its {count} items back in stock.
admin.effect.writeOffItem: Approving keeps it as a loss of {amount} at selling price. Rejecting means the {qty} {unit} must be found or charged.
admin.effect.writeOffLines: Approving takes {amount} off {no} as a loss; the stock does not come back. Rejecting keeps it on the order.
admin.effect.comp: Approving gives it free: {amount} is written off and the {item} comes out of stock.
admin.effect.price: Accepting keeps the sale at {recorded}. Marking it short records {amount} lost on this order.
admin.effect.archived: The product was archived before this sale. Keeping it records the {amount} as sold. Rejecting voids it and returns the stock.
admin.effect.revoked: This phone was revoked, so its record was held back. Adding it puts {amount} in the records as sent. Rejecting leaves it out, on record here.
admin.recon.subtitle: Business day 06:00 to 06:00
admin.recon.noShifts: No shifts were opened on this business day.
admin.recon.shortNote: {name}’s shortfall of {amount} is recorded against that shift.
admin.recon.openNote: {name}’s shift will show here when it is closed on {device}.
admin.recon.compare: Compare what staff recorded with your till statement
admin.recon.tillHint: From the M-Pesa till statement for this business day
admin.recon.enterTill: Type the till total to see the difference.
admin.recon.variance.matches: Every M-Pesa payment is accounted for.
admin.recon.variance.notOnTill: Staff recorded M-Pesa that didn’t arrive. Check the payments below.
admin.recon.variance.notRecorded: Money arrived that no one recorded. It may be a sale that was never entered.
admin.recon.closeHint: Available when every shift is closed and the till total is entered. You can close with a difference, and it’s kept on record.
admin.recon.closedBy: Day closed by {name} at {time}. The till total and any difference are kept on record.
admin.feed.fullHistory: full history in the audit log
admin.feed.serversNote: Amounts in KES. “Not paid” is money still on that server’s open orders. Sales are credited to the server, and the person who recorded them is shown on every row.
admin.product.saved: Saved. Counters get the change when they next sync.
admin.product.isArchived: This product is archived: counters don’t show it.
admin.product.nameSwHint: optional, shown when the counter is in Kiswahili
admin.product.modeChanged: Count the shelf after saving: the stock was counted the other way until now.
admin.product.deductHintMl: A tot is 30 ml here. Change it to match your measure.
admin.product.deductHintCount: Each sale takes away this many items.
admin.product.alertLevel: Warn when stock is at or below
admin.product.error.name: Give the product a name.
admin.product.error.size: Every size needs a label, what it takes away (a whole number above 0) and a price.
admin.product.error.sizes: Keep at least one size on sale, or archive the product.
admin.stock.clears: {name} goes back above zero, from {before} to {after}. The flag on Today will clear.
admin.stock.kegNote: The keg goes into the keg queue. It becomes active when the current one is marked finished.
admin.stock.audit: Recorded in the audit log with your name and the delivery note.
admin.kegs.foam: Some foam loss is normal. Your foam allowance is {count} cups. Change it in settings so small losses don’t raise a flag.
admin.kegs.everySale: See every sale from this keg
admin.kegs.none: No keg products yet. Add a product in the Keg category to track kegs.
admin.kegs.since: Tapped {when}. Since then: {mugs} mugs + {jugs} jugs recorded, which is {litres} L. The level is worked out from sales, not measured.
admin.kegs.noneOnTap: Nothing on tap. Add a keg with a delivery and it goes on tap.
admin.kegs.noneOnTapQueue: Nothing on tap. The next keg in the queue goes on tap when a counter starts selling from it.
admin.kegs.queueNote: When staff tap “Keg finished” on the counter, the next keg in the queue becomes active and the old one gets a summary.
admin.staff.demoCode: This is the demo: no phone can pair with this code. With your Kaunta server set up, the new phone types it to connect.
admin.staff.pairHow: Open Kaunta on the new phone and choose “This is a counter”. Then make a pairing code here.
admin.staff.addHint: Counter staff and admins get a one-time code to set their own PIN at a counter. Servers don’t log in.
admin.staff.codeHow: Give this code to {name}. At a counter they tap their name, type the code and choose a new PIN. It works once, for {hours} hours. It is not shown again.
admin.staff.peopleHint: Counter staff log in with a PIN. Servers who only carry drinks don’t need a login, but they still appear in the server picker.
admin.staff.resetNote: Resetting a PIN gives a one-time code. The person sets their own new PIN at the counter, so admins never see it. Archived people keep their history.
admin.staff.reason.left: Left with someone who no longer works here
admin.staff.revokeNote: Revoking signs the phone out straight away. Anything it saved offline and hasn’t sent yet is held for your review, not thrown away.
admin.audit.linesMoved: Items moved from {from} to a new order {to}
admin.audit.pinSet: New PIN set with a one-time code
admin.audit.handedOver: Order {order} handed over to the next shift
admin.audit.handoverAccepted_one: Took over {count} order from the last shift
admin.audit.handoverAccepted_other: Took over {count} orders from the last shift
admin.signIn.title: Sign in to manage your bar
admin.signIn.body: For owners and admins. Counter staff log in on a counter phone with their PIN.
admin.signIn.wrong: That phone number or password is not right. Try again.
admin.signIn.offline: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
admin.signIn.failed: The server could not sign you in just now. Try again in a minute.
admin.signIn.notAdmin: This account is not an owner or admin of this bar. Ask the owner to add you.
login.reset.enterCode: Type the 6-digit code from your admin
login.reset.wrongCode_one: That code is not right · {count} try left
login.reset.wrongCode_other: That code is not right · {count} tries left
login.reset.mismatch: The two PINs were different. Choose a new PIN again.
login.reset.noPin: {name} has no PIN yet. Ask an admin for a one-time code (Staff & devices → Reset PIN).
